note: For a selected history, `Retreat.reply` states that the mode integrals of the vacuum-stripped density `toll` (e^{−scalar} times `restore`), normalized by `lack`, equal those of the full density normalized by the partition function (`Sever.stamp`); [L] states this cancellation for the integrated mode parts rather than as an identity of densities, with the healthy-indicator energies inside `restore`.

snippet.text: lemma reply (A:History G) {N p m:ℕ}(h:A.Selected)(hx:m≤N) (P: V→ Config G (A.S.side m p)→ℂ) (F:V→ Box (A.S.side m p)→ Config G (A.S.side m p)→ℂ)(i:B.Mode): mid (A.rep N p m) P F i=Sever.stamp A N p m (restore (A.rep N p m) P F 0 0) i:=by
